name: Takaku Tatsuma
source: A survivor of the destroyed evil organization "Imperial Court," he is now the "Last Princess." Although he was once an evil prince, he had no choice but to inherit the role of princess -- thereby becoming only one with the power to truly slay a dragon. Dysfunctional when it comes to communicating with others.
